title: 법원 행정전자서명 인증업무에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:10:0:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 10 (Management of Administrative Digital Signatures)
(1) A subscribing agency, etc. shall securely retain and manage its administrative digital-signature generation key and, where the key is lost, stolen, disclosed, or damaged, shall notify the Certification Management Center without delay. <Amended on November 6, 2019>
(2) The Certification Management Center shall securely retain and manage its administrative digital-signature generation key and, where the relevant electronic information is lost, stolen, disclosed, or damaged, shall notify the Government Certification Management Center without delay and devise measures to ensure the security and reliability of its certification services. <Amended on November 6, 2019>
(3) Guidelines for administrative digital-signature certification services and detailed matters concerning certificate management shall be prescribed by the Director General of the National Court Administration.
